findings.text: a rollout or stream whose final record carries no trailing newline stays in _ReceiptFold.pending for ever once the file stops growing, so that record is never folded where the base whole-file loop at rollout.py:444 of 6fa76c49f4 processed it; all four added tests write a trailing newline, so nothing asserts the divergence.

_LISTINGS and _directory_entries are duplicated verbatim at reckon/crew/metering.py:526-546 in the same change, so one capability now has two copies and a correction to either is invisible to the other.

_rollout_signature and its twin at reckon/crew/metering.py:256 re-implement reckon/file_memo.py:277 file_signature and drop the ctime_ns field listed at :283, so an in-place rewrite that leaves size and mtime unmoved is indistinguishable from an unchanged file and the fold answers with the predecessor's bytes.

_RECEIPTS, _STREAMS at reckon/crew/metering.py:280 and both _LISTINGS stores at rollout.py:192 and metering.py:526 are mutated with no lock, unlike reckon/file_memo.py:57 _LOCK, and the base readers held no shared state, so a station thread and a served request reading one rollout can extend the same fold twice and double-count the appended lines.

cached == fresh runs the same implementation in both arms, so it is independent of the stored summary but not of the fold's arithmetic; the regression it was added to catch is a fold that disagrees with a whole-file read, and that one survives it.
